base_head_role: BASE_ONLY; actual source snapshot and binary hashes identify runtime
source_snapshot_scope: Whole legsa_gins Python package plus native port/build/config and observer sources; identity superset, not executed coverage
host_volume_measurement: Actual Windows G Get-Volume supplied by launcher; WSL df not physical evidence

analysis_preregistration.scope: All45cases and all3methods fixed before corrected results; exploratory paired replay after old results known
analysis_preregistration.common_epochs: Exact saved time microsecond keys; intersection fixed separately per pair/domain; no interpolation
analysis_preregistration.failure_denominator: Original 56642 IMU output epochs remains full-window denominator; report native/matched counts and any failed/unavailable cases
analysis_preregistration.comparison_sign: F04 minus ablation; negative RMSE means lower diagnostic error
analysis_preregistration.statistics: Report every pair, improvement/tie/worsening and anchor-block summaries; nine repeated placement anchors are not 45 independent samples; no confirmatory p claim
analysis_preregistration.reference: Commercial shared-GNSS visual inertial fusion; independent truth and point/covariance equivalence unresolved
analysis_preregistration.not_revalidated: Full6468 matrix; all20 HV contrasts; full-go2-off H3; no same-input external-method ranking
